next_question.rationale: Large 'abandoned by system' (54,015) and 'abandoned from the patient selection screen' (4,134) suggest many auto-cancels or failures that happen when users request immediate/unscheduled consults. I expect 'instant' requests to show materially lower created→confirmed conversion than 'scheduled' ones. Showing scheduling will identify whether routing/doctor-availability is the primary mechanism. Also request delivery_channel as a second cut to see whether chat vs video (or other channels) explains part of the loss by having different availability/acceptance rates.
